input_binding: Fixed typed constants, independently mapped to these pinned fixtures. The adapter does not read TOML; the external receipt must verify fixture, source, adapter, dependency and executable pins.

typed_mapping.ranges: native Range::from_str, then PostflopHands::from_ranges; all retained weights are one
typed_mapping.units: 10 chips per bb; pot=200, effective_stack=900, min_bet=10
typed_mapping.tree: Exact script body is compiled by Script<PostflopVar>::compile with empty overrides and POSTFLOP. Each street uses StreetTree::from_script(cap=2, include_allin=false, allin_threshold=None).
typed_mapping.run_fields: No solver is instantiated. DCFR, F32, iterations=100, time=30s, check_every=10, threads=1, chance_depth=2 and min_children=12 are not exercised.

default_count: memory_usage visits the native betting/chance recursion and retains distinct completed-board keys. It does not create TempNodes, masks, rank entries or solver arenas. Counts are not OS peak-memory bounds.
optional_build: Explicit --build only. Constructs tree, masks, rank tables and CLI-style node metadata using the same config. No solver storage, CFR or EV/BR. Emits a second JSON line. Count output is flushed first, so a bounded build failure retains its count result.
comparison: Checks native root combo IDs/support and compatible pair mass. Count fields match static-check.json; build fields match count and static per-street bet/raise availability. Actual rank-table count is not exposed publicly and is not asserted from the built evaluator.
cli_boundary: Native typed API/script/range parsing validation only; not a test of TOML parsing, public-schema normalization, CLI errors or run settings.
external_limits: Caller must supervise one process at a time. Count first; optional build has a separately authorized bounded execution (requested 60 seconds, 512 MiB hard job cap). A successful estimate does not authorize an unbounded build or solve.
